title: The Ooze Rift · The Thing Beyond
dek: A reunion across islands becomes a fight against multiplying, recovering oozes. Beyond the closing breach waits a far larger creature, while the travelers race to pass news and tuning forks before they part.

facts.Recorded dates: Source posts · 17–18 April 2025 · in-world date unresolved
facts.People: Elenia; Arjahn; Ryvyt; Farkur; Olokun; Nimueh; Krone
facts.Outcome: Immediate attackers defeated; pools recede and the rift closes. A castle-sized ooze remains beyond it. Olokun hands Ryvyt tuning forks; later journeys remain separate outcomes.

body:
The tear is already changing Fenumion when the adventurers answer it. Yellow-green ooze seeps through the opening, dissolving and reshaping the ground. The company can fight what comes out, but to stop the spread it first has to step into the substance doing the damage.

Through the slime

The expedition recorded on 17, Month of Namo’o, Year 2 brings companions together from separate islands. Elenia charges toward what she feels as a divine call. Farkur follows his own sense of being summoned. Ryvyt leaves work on a boat’s engine to run after him. Arjahn enters uneasily, using his Voyager Staff to steady himself on the uncertain footing.

Olokun has barely finished one battle before finding himself at another. He and Arjahn greet each other with relief; Krone recognizes Ryvyt, who leaps up to hug him and introduces Farkur as his brother. The breach briefly gives people separated by dangerous travel a place to meet.

Their boots sink into slime that smells of lavender, rot and wet animal. The route leads to a broad space filled with pools of many colors, all slowly bubbling and draining back toward the opening. Then shapes rise out of the pools and advance. The material flowing into Fenumion is inhabited.

News carried between islands

Before the fight has their full attention, ordinary needs and bad news pass through the reunion. Farkur asks whether the far-traveled arrivals have building materials to spare. Arjahn asks about Scribonia and Gartina. Olokun says Scribonia was lost to the Void; Elenia says she has not yet been able to bring him back. Arjahn reports that Gartina has disappeared from Gael and that he still needs to investigate.

These are the things the companions know, fear or have heard at this point. They do not establish a permanent fate for either missing friend. Nimueh introduces herself while Elenia asks about the goddess she invokes. Even here, the adventurers do not share one set of beliefs or the same news from home.

Olokun calls them back to the immediate danger. The reunion has happened in the middle of an advancing enemy. Whatever comfort it offers will matter little if they cannot survive the place that made it possible.

Attacks that do not work

Farkur tests his crossbow against an ooze. The blow that should have an additional effect does not produce it. He continues firing and protects his defender, while Arjahn weighs his stronger spells against the need to conserve energy. The company is learning that familiar equipment does not necessarily work as expected here.

The ooze facing Olokun has a single eye. It strikes him, then throws a collection of bones out of its body. The bones animate into an undead attacker. Closing with one creature has exposed him to another, made from something the ooze has been carrying inside itself.

Krone grows until his steps shake the ground and swings a burning maul with his enlarged reach. Elenia answers the gathering enemies with light and asks the others to let them cluster together. Arjahn watches her approach and begins preparing one of his most powerful spells. They have different strengths, but the fight is beginning to demand that they use them together.

A mistake becomes two enemies

Nimueh drives her staff down and releases lightning. The creature splits into two. She immediately recognizes the mistake; the narrator offers the small consolation that the two puddings are smaller. The party now has more enemies to handle because an attack worked differently than she intended.

Elenia keeps sending light into the fight and urges the others to stop making more opponents. Farkur adds magic to his crossbow shot against the ooze before him. Arjahn turns his attention toward another target, then admits the strain of using such a powerful spell. Elenia praises him, and he credits the idea he took from her.

Meanwhile the black oozes draw strength from the surrounding mass. Their bodies regain size and substance while the adventurers are spending energy to break them down. The ground is supporting the creatures as surely as a supply line supports an army. Success requires keeping pressure on them long enough to overcome that recovery.

Elenia blasts what she thinks is the last ooze, but one remains by Farkur. Arjahn turns back and hits its center with a final beam. It splatters onto the slime-covered ground. The immediate attackers are finally down.

The pools recede

The pools begin to withdraw like an outgoing tide. A gurgling sound accompanies the closing breach. The company has survived the fight in front of it, but the retreating slime uncovers something far larger: an ooze nearly the size of a castle, angry and staring toward them.

Arjahn asks whether the others saw it too. Elenia suggests that Cala may be dealing with it, but nothing in the scene confirms her hope. No one defeats this larger creature in the recovered account. It remains on the other side as the planar pull begins drawing the travelers home.

The sight changes what their victory means. The smaller enemies are dead and the outflow is receding in this scene. The enormous creature and the place supporting it remain. The closing boundary saves the company from having to settle that greater danger now.

Tuning forks before the company parts

Olokun uses the last moments together to ask who can travel between planes. Elenia raises her hand. Arjahn says he would need an idea of his destination and a tuning fork, but he must return to Gael: Gartina is missing, and the refugees still need to be fed.

Farkur calls out for components and relics needed in Pristinia. Ryvyt asks about a crystal that could let a boat reach Gael and Fein Uaill. Olokun wants Elenia to go to Prima and exchange tuning forks so that the islands can stay in contact. She objects that she has no way there and does not think the closing rift can simply carry her with someone else.

Rather than leave everything as a request, Olokun hands Ryvyt tuning forks for Fein Uaill and the Void. Ryvyt accepts and stores them separately. He wants a meeting with Fein’s leaders. The exchange puts useful objects into another traveler’s hands; it does not show that meeting taking place or establish a new, completed travel service.

The breach has exposed the company to an alien threat and briefly connected people whose settlements need one another. Before that connection closes, they try to turn a chance encounter into a means of meeting again.

The pull home

Reality snaps back. The travelers are pulled toward the lands from which they came. The final exchanges leave Ryvyt with the forks and Elenia uncertain about exactly where the others expect her to go. Reaching the same battlefield has not made the distance between their homes disappear.

The expedition closes the immediate encounter without answering the origin of the oozes, the extent of the altered ground or the larger creature’s fate. Its lasting human consequence is more tangible: people have exchanged news, recognized absences and passed on tools for another crossing. Read what the other rift encounters establish →
